issue.title: Repair Artifacts Files PNG detail monkeypatch after pane split
issue.description: Proposed by phase sase-mf.4 and independently reproduced by land agent on current master 3c3909c31: tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_artifacts_files.py::test_artifacts_files_populated_png_snapshot fails before rendering because it monkeypatches files_pane.load_file_detail, removed by c756a7c63 when Files pane detail loading moved to a focused module. Repoint the stale test seam to the owning module and verify the affected PNG snapshot plus Artifacts Files visual coverage. This is unrelated to sase-mf's model-routing work; it is fallout from the concurrent Files pane split.

evidence.note: Independently reproduced during the artifacts_shared_grouping tale (sase-m6.7.1.5): also confirmed on a clean git stash at HEAD (02bd00833) that the AttributeError predates the current grouping work and is unrelated to it.

Independently reproduced by sase-m6.land while landing epic sase-m6, on master 5703667f0 in workspace sase_12 after a from-scratch 'just install'. 'just test-visual' -> tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_artifacts_files.py::test_artifacts_files_populated_png_snapshot fails before any PNG comparison with AttributeError: <module 'sase.ace.tui.widgets.artifacts.files_options'> has no attribute 'local_now', i.e. the monkeypatch target moved in the c756a7c63 pane split exactly as described. Still live after this epic's coordinated golden regeneration: it is one of only 5 remaining failures in an otherwise green 692-passing visual suite, and it is NOT fixed by regenerating goldens because the test errors during setup. Not caused by epic sase-m6 -- the Artifacts Files pane sits on the shared contract/query engine and its own contract conformance tests pass (181 nodes in tests/ace/tui/artifacts_contract/).
